Expected key: Abduljaleel2023.
- (miscited) "\textcite{Frey2012} call for testing each preferential-flow component individually, validating them in the field, and analysing the individual impact of each component on water quality, including extreme values" -- this content (test each preferential flow component individually, validate in field, individual impact on water quality, extreme values) matches the Allaire2011 findings, not Frey2012 (whose finding concerns characterising near-surface preferential flow paths). Expected key: Allaire2011.
- (miscited) "\textcite{Allred2021} lay out an extensive UAV agenda: additional visible, multispectral, and thermal-infrared surveys at multiple farm sites visited repeatedly over two years ... soil temperature and emissivity measurements in small test plots ... band stacking with decorrelation stretch, minimum-noise-fraction and principal-component transforms; supervised machine-learning algorithms ... and decision-tree guidelines for practitioners" -- this detailed multi-modal (VIS/MS/TIR, six sites, two-year, test plots, band stacking, decision tree) agenda matches the Allred2020 findings, not Allred2021 (whose findings are limited to UAV TIR mapping). Expected key: Allred2020.
- (miscited) "Geophysical evaluations echo these needs: near-surface geophysical data from more sites and diverse soils \parencite{Allred2022}" -- 'near-surface geophysical data of all types, from a larger number of [sites], under a greater variety of soil conditions' matches the Allred2005 findings, not Allred2022 (UAV TIR outlet mapping). Expected key: Allred2005.
- (miscited) "systematic testing of antenna configuration, frequency, and antenna-to-pipe orientation across soil types for GPR \parencite{Koganti2021}" -- testing of antenna configurations, antenna frequencies, and antenna-to-pipe orientation across diverse soil types matches the Allred2013 findings, not Koganti2021. Expected key: Allred2013.
